description.value: Whether it springs from a love of exploration, a desire for freedom, or a need for speed, you're never happier than when you're behind the wheel of a vehicle or at the helm of a starship. You become trained in Piloting, or if you're already trained in Piloting, you instead become expert in Piloting. You gain a +1 circumstance bonus on Piloting checks to @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.Navigate], @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.Plot Course], @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.Stunt], and perform starship actions at the piloting station. When you roll a success on a check to Navigate or Plot Course, you get a critical success instead.
